# EOS ADMIN POLICY LANE -- RELEVANT PATHS (the single source of truth).
#
# Read by scripts/adminPolicyCiRelevance.mjs in the `changes` job of
# .github/workflows/eos-admin-policy-tests.yml. A pull request or push to main whose diff touches ANY
# path matched here runs the `policy` and `surfaces` jobs; anything else skips them at job level, so the
# required check "Admin policy engine -- authorization, workflow, tenancy, schema, seed" still REPORTS
# (as skipped) on every pull request instead of waiting forever on a run that path filters never start.
#
# Format: one GitHub-style glob per line (`**` crosses `/`, `*` does not). `#` starts a comment line;
# blank lines are ignored. No negation (`!`), no braces. Order and duplicates are immaterial.
#
# This replaced the two `paths:` trigger filters (pull_request and push) that the workflow used to
# carry. Their union, byte-for-byte per entry, is what follows; the comments are the ones those filters
# carried; the sections at the end are additions, each explained there. Register a new suite or
# subject HERE -- and only here. scripts/adminPolicyCiRelevance.test.mjs (COMPLETENESS) fails if any
# suite the gated jobs run is not selected by this list.
